en-US.name: Flash Deck
en-US.summary: Flashcards with pictures and animations for Echo Show — study by voice, edit from your phone.
en-US.description:
Flash Deck turns your Echo Show into a study machine.

STUDY BY VOICE OR TOUCH
Say a deck name, flip cards by voice or with a tap, and grade yourself with "got it" or "missed it". Spaced repetition (Leitner boxes) brings back the cards you miss more often, so your weak spots get the reps.

CARDS WITH PICTURES AND ANIMATIONS
Cards can carry images or looping animations — see the flag, watch the exercise, not just read the word.

EDIT FROM YOUR PHONE
Add cards and whole decks from a companion web editor on your phone; they appear on your Echo Show within a minute. No app install required.

VOICE NOTES
Say "note" plus anything — it becomes a card on your My Notes deck, like a post-it board for your kitchen.

Starter decks include World Capitals, Spanish Basics, Security Plus, and Exercise Form.
examplePhrases: Alexa, ask flash deck to quiz me on world capitals
Alexa, tell flash deck to note buy milk

publishingInformation.testingInstructions: Open the skill ('Alexa, open flash deck') — a deck menu renders on screen. Say 'study world capitals' (or tap a deck tile), say 'flip' to reveal the answer, then 'got it' or 'missed it'. Say 'note test note' to save a voice note, then 'study my notes' to review it. Requires an APL device for visuals; voice-only devices get speech without screens.
